objective: improve the hero without changing the approved offer
completion_condition: the frozen criteria pass with no hard failure

execution_plan.name: Freeze the baseline
execution_plan.action: capture the current state and available evidence
execution_plan.purpose: establish a reliable reference before changing anything
execution_plan.next: use only demonstrated gaps in the next step

execution_plan.name: Test the main hypothesis
execution_plan.action: compare the baseline with the frozen decision criteria
execution_plan.purpose: identify the highest-value gap blocking PASS
execution_plan.output: a prioritized gap with supporting evidence
execution_plan.next: change only the component responsible for that gap

topology_rationale: the selected mechanism is sufficient to create verifiable progress without unnecessary complexity

complexity_gate.limitation: the simpler option does not capture the dominant mechanism when escalation is needed
complexity_gate.expected_gain: better fit between control flow and verifiable progress

cycle_action: perform the smallest useful approved action

verification.independent_terminal_verifier: independent reviewer against the frozen rubric

proxy_hardening.attack_path: lower the threshold or reinterpret the rubric

no_progress_rule: stop after 2 cycles without material progress
